entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: I did it, I reached the maximum idol rank!!! I’m going to become a world famous idol!

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: ….Hahahahahahhaha……

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: The fuck are you laughing at

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: Did you actually think you could become a singer just like this? Beating people on a campus nobody cares about?

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: Why do you think people with no talent make it to the top of society, people who aren’t actually that talented, and can somehow get away with all their controversies.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: Because that’s the real word Miku, if you don’t have connections or money, you’re nobody. Do you hear me? NOBODY. You are NOTHING.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: Your dreams are worth NOTHING. You major in Computer Science, right? Do you think your classmates actually enjoy coding? Do they enjoy problem solving? After that, the average grade in the C exam didn’t exceed 74.668? AI is just so convenient isn’t it?

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: No they don’t, they’re only here for a credit check. Nobody has any passion, everyone is just working hard because they have to, the “hard” part is also debatable for certain people... The longer you keep your dream of singing, the more you’ll lag behind everyone.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: And did you even bother to read the contract before signing it?

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: This so-called “contest” was nothing more than a data collection experiment. I am an employee of CaiNiao corporation, I am their Reinforcement Learning specialist.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: As you know, reinforcement learning works through trial-and-error by trying to maximise the most rewards as possible-

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Eh, I actually didn’t know that. You know I got like a 42 in AI last semester, right?

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: You know the average grade for that exam is 85.975. Just… how could you have failed? Did your group get a bad grade?? What group were you part of? CTRL V that we gave a 0 during the peer review because they had literally 0 PPTs or videos or assignments on their Lexue??

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: You know I got like a 1.8 GPA right?

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: AND YOU’RE A FULL SCHOLARSHIP STUDENT? MEANWHILE THEY GAVE ME A 15% SCHOLARSHIP THIS IS SO UNFA-

entries.speaker: Cupcakke
entries.text: I got a 69% scholarship.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: Nobody ASKED.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: Ahem… Let me continue my evil antagonist monologue.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: Since you have been winning the most duels, the AI has learned how to sing like you. Let me show you an example.

entries.speaker: System
entries.text: plays We are Charlie Kirk Hatsune Miku remix

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: OH!..... That… is…. NOT me.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: Oh! I know that! It's our Intellectual Property now. You may be a nobody but at least your voice can bring us some value now that we own it.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: Our goal is to crash the music Industry by imploding it, we want to flood the music Industry with AI-generated slop music.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: I won’t let you take my voice away from me…. and I won’t let you take my DREAMS from me!

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: No matter how messed up this world can be, I’ll hold onto my dreams, even if they never become true.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: But one thing that I will never do is give up, and I most certainly won’t give up AGAINST YOU!

entries.speaker: Lyoo & Miku
entries.text: Let’s get on stage, AND SING UNTIL OUR LAST BREATH!
